metadata.name: rag__unified_document
metadata.comment: Each record represents a chunk of text prepared for semantic-search and additional fields for use in LLM workflows.

unique_id.name: unique_id
unique_id.comment: Unique identifier of the table represented as a combination of document_id, platform, chunk_index, and source_relation fields.

document_id.name: document_id
document_id.comment: Identifier of the base object which the unstructured data is associated (ie. Zendesk ticket_id, Jira issue_id, and HubSpot deal_id).

title.name: title
title.comment: Title of the base object which the unstructured data is associated to. This will be the Zendesk ticket subject, Jira issue summary, or HubSpot deal name if found (otherwise the email_subject or the string `engagement_note`).

url_reference.name: url_reference
url_reference.comment: URL reference to the respective base object.

platform.name: platform
platform.comment: Record identifying the respective upstream connector type (ie. HubSpot, Jira, Zendesk).

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The source of the record if the unioning functionality is being used. If it is not this field will be empty.

most_recent_chunk_update.name: most_recent_chunk_update
most_recent_chunk_update.comment: Timestamp indicating the most recent update to the overall chunk.

update_date.name: update_date
update_date.comment: Truncated date of the most_recent_chunk_update field used for incremental and partition logic.

chunk_index.name: chunk_index
chunk_index.comment: The index of the chunk associated with the `document_id`.

chunk_tokens_approximate.name: chunk_tokens_approximate
chunk_tokens_approximate.comment: Approximate number of tokens for the chunk, assuming 4 characters per token.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

team_id.name: team_id

metadata.comment: Table of all issues in your organization's Jira (captures soft deletes).

source_relation.comment: The source of the record if the unioning functionality is being used. If it is not this field will be empty.

original_estimate_seconds.name: original_estimate_seconds
original_estimate_seconds.comment: The original estimate of how long working on this issue would take, in seconds.

remaining_estimate_seconds.name: remaining_estimate_seconds
remaining_estimate_seconds.comment: The estimate of how much longer working on this issue will take, in seconds.

time_spent_seconds.name: time_spent_seconds
time_spent_seconds.comment: The time that was spent working on this issue, in seconds.

assignee_user_id.name: assignee_user_id
assignee_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the ID of the `user` currently assigned to this task.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.comment: Timestamp of when the issue was created (in UTC).

resolved_at.name: resolved_at
resolved_at.comment: Timestamp of when the issue was resolved (ie completed, marked as duplicate). If an issue is un-resolved, this will be null.

creator_user_id.name: creator_user_id
creator_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the `user` who first created the issue. Cannot be changed.

due_date.name: due_date
due_date.comment: Calendar day on which the issue is due, if a due date is provided.

environment.name: environment
environment.comment: Text field describing the environment in which the issue occurred (ie "IE9 on Windows 7").

issue_type_id.name: issue_type_id
issue_type_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the ID of the `issue_type`.

priority_id.name: priority_id
priority_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the ID of the issue's current `priority`.

project_id.name: project_id
project_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the ID of the `project` that the issue belongs to.

reporter_user_id.name: reporter_user_id
reporter_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the ID of the `user` who reported the issue. This differs from the `creator` column  in that the reporter can be changed in-app.

resolution_id.name: resolution_id
resolution_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the ID of the issue's type of `resolution`.

status_id.name: status_id
status_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the ID of the issue's `status` (the step that the issue is currently at  in the project's workflow).

status_changed_at.name: status_changed_at
status_changed_at.comment: Timestamp of when the status was last changed.

updated_at.name: updated_at
updated_at.comment: Timestamp of when the issue was last updated in some way.

work_ratio.name: work_ratio
work_ratio.comment: The percentage of work that has been logged against the issue (time_spent) vs the original estimate of worktime. Equals -1.0 when the fields required for calculation are not provided.

metadata.comment: Zendesk Support has three types of users, end-users (your customers), agents, and administrators.

user_id.name: user_id
user_id.comment: Automatically assigned when the user is created

external_id.comment: A unique identifier from another system. The API treats the id as case insensitive.

_fivetran_deleted.comment: Boolean created by Fivetran to indicate whether the record has been deleted.

last_login_at.comment: Last time the user signed in to Zendesk Support or made an API request using an API token or basic authentication.

created_at.comment: The time the user was created

updated_at.name: updated_at
updated_at.comment: The time the user was last updated.

email.name: email
email.comment: The user's primary email address. *Writeable on create only. On update, a secondary email is added. See Email Address

organization_id.name: organization_id
organization_id.comment: The id of the user's organization. If the user has more than one organization memberships, the id of the user's default organization

role.name: role
role.comment: The user's role. Possible values are "end-user", "agent", or "admin"

ticket_restriction.name: ticket_restriction
ticket_restriction.comment: Specifies which tickets the user has access to. Possible values are organization, groups, assigned, requested and null

time_zone.name: time_zone
time_zone.comment: The user's time zone. See Time Zone

is_active.name: is_active
is_active.comment: false if the user has been deleted

is_suspended.name: is_suspended
is_suspended.comment: Boolean representing whether the user has been suspended, meaning that they can no longer sign in and any new support requests you receive from them are sent to the suspended tickets queue.

source_relation.comment: The source of the record if the unioning functionality is being used. If it is not this field will be empty.
